chapters.title: One carrier, two faces, three relations

claimDetails.heading: Scope and method
claimDetails.claim: This book asks how positive composition, typed carriers, transformation, dynamics and observation can be held in one research architecture without being declared identical. It begins from ordinary measuring ideas, states each mathematical object and then follows only the bridges for which a map or explicit test is available.

claimDetails.heading: Scope and method
claimDetails.claim: The labels established, conditional, obstruction and open are part of the result. A beautiful chain of mathematics is not converted into a physical theory by typography or narrative momentum.

claimDetails.heading: The authority boundary
claimDetails.claim: This volume reports calculations and constructions internal to declared models. It is not empirical confirmation, peer review, or a derivation of the Standard Model. Every strong sentence carries a nearby statement of what it does not establish.

claimDetails.heading: A book of layers
claimDetails.claim: A ruler can tell you the length of a table without telling you why the table exists. A compass can preserve a direction without choosing which direction should count as north. Much of this programme has the same layered character. It contains exact measuring structures, conditional mechanisms and proposed physical interpretations. The reader should not flatten those layers into one claim.

claimDetails.heading: A book of layers
claimDetails.claim: Each chapter therefore moves in the same order: ordinary picture, defined object, exact result, and authority boundary. A term such as symplectic is introduced only after the familiar idea it formalizes: preserving oriented area in a phase-space plane. A term such as chirality is introduced only after the familiar idea: left- and right-handed patterns cannot always be superposed by rotation.

claimDetails.heading: Four labels used throughout
claimDetails.claim: Established means that a calculation follows from its written assumptions and has an executable or inspectable certificate. Conditional means that a construction works after a named field, coefficient, boundary condition or control is supplied. Externally open means that the missing ingredient is not contained in the current corpus. Internally exhausted means that further rearrangement of the same ingredients no longer addresses the missing datum.

claimDetails.heading: Four labels used throughout
claimDetails.claim: None of these labels means true of nature. Even an exact theorem can describe the wrong physical system. Conversely, a blocked physical programme can contain useful mathematics, simulation tools and experimentally transferable methods.

claimDetails.heading: The route through the book
claimDetails.claim: The admissibility frontier comes first because it identifies the changed route to discovery: recover distinctions that ordinary measurements erase, then trace their admission, dynamics and detection. The following chapters build one exact Jordan-to-Lie rank-two hinge from response measurements and relational loops before asking whether it can carry Standard-Model matter, safe interactions or exceptional structure. The result ledger records positive findings and reversals; the research frontier ends in controlled experiments and explicit reopening conditions rather than in a larger symmetry slogan.

claimDetails.heading: Things before names
claimDetails.claim: Begin with the preparation, response table, path, boundary, update or detector record before introducing the algebraic name that compresses it. Show what can be done to the thing and what remains unchanged. Technical language then becomes earned precision rather than an entrance fee.

claimDetails.heading: Things before names
claimDetails.claim: For example, two coupled readouts and their nonnegative response come before H₂(ℝ); eliminating a hidden component comes before the Schur complement and Jordan triple; transport around a loop and a changed return come before holonomy.

claimDetails.heading: Every bridge carries a reason
claimDetails.claim: Two technical nouns placed beside one another do not explain their relationship. Every material bridge must say why the things are alike, why they differ, what produces the difference, whether its mathematical and physical parts are open or closed, what follows, what does not follow and which calculation or observation would decide the remainder.

claimDetails.heading: Every bridge carries a reason
claimDetails.claim: The compact grammar is because—but—therefore—still open. An unlabeled arrow, shared name, repeated number or similar diagram is a prompt to investigate, not a completed bridge.

claimDetails.heading: Pictures and speculation are optional
claimDetails.claim: Landscape, grammar, network, workshop, ecological, mythic and theological pictures may be offered after the reason-bearing core. They form a menu, not a ladder of belief: a reader may use the theorem or experiment while rejecting every optional interpretation.

claimDetails.heading: Pictures and speculation are optional
claimDetails.claim: A picture must pass deletion and substitution tests. Removing it or replacing it with another picture must leave the typed objects, reason, status, implication and test unchanged; otherwise it carries a hidden premise.

claimDetails.heading: The shift
claimDetails.claim: The next route to new physics may begin not with higher energy but with greater finesse: preserving phase, delay, boundary order, memory, orientation and cross-channel relation that ordinary measurements average away. The programme therefore begins where candidate mechanisms become observationally equivalent and asks which erased distinction would separate them.

claimDetails.heading: The shift
claimDetails.claim: This is a change of protagonist. Spin₀(2,3) and the larger symmetry landscape no longer lead the story. The admission–dynamics–detection loop does, because it determines which mathematical differences can become physical records.

claimDetails.heading: Why Jordan and Lie must be balanced
claimDetails.claim: Jordan structure delimits what can coexist and compose as positive states, responses and observables. Lie structure describes how those admitted objects transform and circulate. Jordan has explanatory priority; Lie has dynamical necessity; neither can supply the carrier, selector and detector alone.

claimDetails.heading: Why Jordan and Lie must be balanced
claimDetails.claim: Spin₀(2,3) is an exact conformal completion of one declared rank-two Jordan response cone. It is therefore a recovered symmetry of an admitted geometry, not the prior container of physics.

claimDetails.heading: Dynamics moves the boundary
claimDetails.claim: Bound states, boundary bands, resonances and free continua are joined by spectral flow, capture, decay and memory. Dynamics is tested by what it preserves, which context selects a history and which record survives finite detection—not only by whether an equation of motion can be written.

claimDetails.heading: Dynamics moves the boundary
claimDetails.claim: This turns Casimir response, thermoelectric transport, holonomy, hysteresis, metastability and scattering delay into complementary probes of a changing admissibility boundary.

claimDetails.heading: The third term is the mediator
claimDetails.claim: A boundary, selector, environment, memory kernel or detector orientation can mediate the relation between nominal endpoints. Ternary structure makes this context-dependence explicit: changing the middle term can change the admissible relation without changing the endpoints.

claimDetails.heading: The third term is the mediator
claimDetails.claim: The scientific question behind retained identity or ‘soul’ is whether a measurable invariant survives transformation, descent and observation. This does not declare a soul to be a field or particle.

claimDetails.heading: The finesse technology pathway
claimDetails.claim: The practical sequence is to find a mechanism collision, identify the erased distinction, build a detector or reversal that retains it and replicate any residual on an independent carrier. Phase-sensitive controls, nonlinear correlators, boundary-order probes, memory-aware inference and same-material response closure are the immediate tools.

claimDetails.heading: The finesse technology pathway
claimDetails.claim: Each experiment has two valuable outcomes: improved theory or technology if established physics closes the record, and a disciplined anomaly path if a preregistered residual survives nuisance models, reversals and cross-carrier replication. Only the latter sequence can promote the result toward new physics.

claimDetails.heading: What remains open

claimDetails.heading: Begin with a measuring frame
claimDetails.claim: Imagine recording two coupled signals: two voltages, two oscillator amplitudes or two stress readouts. Their self-responses and cross-response form a symmetric two-by-two table. Requiring every real combination of the signals to have nonnegative power makes that table positive. This positive cone is the everyday entrance to H₂(ℝ), the Jordan algebra of real symmetric two-by-two matrices.

claimDetails.heading: Begin with a measuring frame
claimDetails.claim: The Jordan product X∘Y=(XY+YX)/2 keeps the result symmetric even when ordinary matrix multiplication does not. It is useful when the object of interest is a state or response cone rather than an ordered sequence of operations.

claimDetails.heading: From elimination to symmetry
claimDetails.claim: When an internal degree of freedom is removed from a coupled quadratic system, the effective response is a Schur complement. Repeating that operation produces the same triple combination that appears in Jordan theory. The Tits–Kantor–Koecher construction then packages translations, linear transformations and their opposites into a graded Lie algebra.

claimDetails.heading: From elimination to symmetry
claimDetails.claim: For the declared carrier, the closure is ten-dimensional 𝔰𝔭(4,ℝ). This algebra preserves a nondegenerate oriented-area form on four real phase-space coordinates. A standard low-rank isomorphism identifies its connected group with Spin₀(2,3), the double cover of the identity component of SO(2,3).

claimDetails.heading: Why ten generators are a real gate
claimDetails.claim: Four real coordinates do not automatically imply 𝔰𝔭(4,ℝ). A pair of ordinary oscillators can explore only a three-generator squeezing/rotation subalgebra. Reaching ten requires independently available anisotropies and shears. The corpus therefore treats generator rank as a kill test: if commutators close at three, the model is a lower-rank control, not hidden full Spin(2,3).

claimDetails.heading: Algebra is not yet spacetime
claimDetails.claim: A symmetry can act on response coordinates without acting on physical events. Calling the response cone spacetime would require a Lorentzian state space, causal localization, a physical inner product and a map to measured rods and clocks. The current result establishes an exact algebraic hinge and deliberately stops before that interpretation.

claimDetails.heading: The smallest relational closure
claimDetails.claim: Two faces define a comparison, but a third relation is the first place where local pairwise consistency can fail around a loop. This is why the gear intuition becomes mathematically meaningful at three: not because the universe is literally geared, but because an odd cycle detects a return defect invisible on a single edge.

claimDetails.heading: The smallest relational closure
claimDetails.claim: The same grammar appears in two-port response matrices, Peirce off-diagonal spaces, placement triangles and three-edge Wilson data. What is shared is a typed relational pattern, not an identity of physical mechanisms.

claimDetails.heading: Jordan recursion
claimDetails.claim: For block-positive response matrices, eliminating an interior degree of freedom produces a Schur complement. Written in Jordan language, the correction is a triple operation. Repeated elimination therefore supplies a concrete meaning for Jordan-triple recursion: local consistency under composition.

claimDetails.heading: Why two is comparison and three is consistency
claimDetails.claim: Two rulers can disagree, but the disagreement is only pairwise. Add a third ruler and one may compare 1 with 2, 2 with 3, and 3 back with 1. The final comparison can fail to return to the starting convention. Three is therefore the smallest cycle that can store a relational defect.

claimDetails.heading: Why two is comparison and three is consistency
claimDetails.claim: This is the grounded meaning of the programme's recurring three. It is not a numerological claim that every appearance of three has one cause. The number can count edges of a minimal loop, components of a response cone, families, or a bundle degree; a valid bridge must say which object is being counted and which map preserves the count.

claimDetails.heading: Faces and the off-diagonal channel
claimDetails.claim: A two-by-two response has two diagonal entries—its faces—and one off-diagonal channel connecting them. Positivity constrains the channel by the two faces, just as the diagonal length of a rectangle is constrained by its sides. Peirce decomposition is the algebraic name for separating those diagonal and connecting pieces.

claimDetails.heading: Faces and the off-diagonal channel

Audits of CP, CPT, residual ℤ₃, boundary orientation, Yukawa phases, a sterile Majorana term and the index-three construction leave a continuous phase circle unfixed.

claimDetails.heading: The selector problem
claimDetails.claim: The smallest named remedy is a physical complex reference with charge minus two, together with a local portal that locks it to the charged carrier. Until that reference is derived or measured, the matter selection is a conditional decision rule rather than an outcome of the theory.

claimDetails.heading: The attractive construction
claimDetails.claim: The minimal Standard-Model field completion points toward dimension-six S₁ exchange operators. They reproduce the two desired crossed arms with the required relative structure.

claimDetails.heading: The uncomfortable edge
claimDetails.claim: The same mediator generically closes a triangle and generates a third Wilson edge. One copy is rank-obstructed; copies preserving the same positive Clebsch orientation do not cancel it. A pure star must therefore be derived by a new incidence rule, involution or boundary mechanism—or abandoned.

claimDetails.heading: What c, L and Y mean
claimDetails.claim: In the Standard-Model algebra su(3)c⊕su(2)L⊕u(1)Y, c labels colour, the three-way charge carried by quarks; L labels the weak interaction acting on left-handed doublets; and Y is hypercharge, the bookkeeping quantity which combines with weak isospin to give electric charge. These labels are directions in an internal measuring system, not ordinary colours, locations or heights.

claimDetails.heading: What c, L and Y mean
claimDetails.claim: The direct-sum sign means that these symmetry instructions coexist. It does not say that a larger group has already explained why nature chose them or why matter occupies its observed chiral representations.

claimDetails.heading: Fit capacity versus derivation
claimDetails.claim: A sufficiently flexible effective action can reproduce Standard-Model masses and mixing parameters. That demonstrates compatibility, much as an adjustable curve can pass through many points. It does not predict the points. The current decoupling limit has ample flavour capacity, so its success is a consistency witness rather than a derivation.

claimDetails.heading: The chiral fold obstruction
claimDetails.claim: A mirror turns a left glove into a right glove. Likewise, spatial reflection exchanges left- and right-handed Weyl spinors. The bosonic fold can have healthy masses and residues while the fermionic theory remains undefined, because the undoubled chiral Standard Model does not supply the same-representation partner required by the reflection.

claimDetails.heading: The chiral fold obstruction
claimDetails.claim: The next valid object is therefore not another positive bosonic spectrum. It is a declared fermion boundary domain—bag, APS/inflow, vectorlike or another explicit construction—followed by self-adjointness, gauge consistency and BRST cohomology on that same domain.

claimDetails.heading: Three generations and the index
claimDetails.claim: An index is a robust signed count of zero modes, rather like counting unmatched left-moving and right-moving lanes after paired lanes cancel. The selected-projector completion canonically pulls back the anticanonical line on ℂP¹ to O(3), giving Dirac index three for every spectator Standard-Model multiplet.

claimDetails.heading: Three generations and the index
claimDetails.claim: That is the programme's strongest typed bridge to three families. Its minimal local six-dimensional realization is nevertheless anomalous, and the obvious vectorlike repair restores mirror families. The bundle explains a count; it does not yet provide an acceptable parent theory.

claimDetails.heading: Complete multiplets are not automatically safe
claimDetails.claim: Unified representations carry wanted and unwanted channels together. The proton-safe projector exists only after reducing the colour–lepton symmetry that made the complete multiplet attractive in the first place.

claimDetails.heading: The surviving route
claimDetails.claim: A finite Pati–Salam reconstruction supplies a concrete source split, while an all-orders rank-one normal form protects part of it. The simplest U(1) and universal Z₂ protections fail. The first surviving family-universal cyclic witness is a Z₉ lift whose faithful low-energy quotient is baryon triality.

claimDetails.heading: The surviving route
claimDetails.claim: This is a live conditional route, not closure: global anomalies, heavy thresholds, the full finite triple and the third edge remain decisive gates.

claimDetails.heading: Why a multiplet brings unwanted companions
claimDetails.claim: Buying a complete toolkit gives both the tool you wanted and the tools packed beside it. Unified gauge multiplets behave similarly: symmetry relates desired leptoquark interactions to diquark partners capable of destabilizing the proton. The problem is not merely finding a useful mediator but explaining why its dangerous companions are absent or ineffective.

claimDetails.heading: From continuous charges to triality
claimDetails.claim: The simplest family-universal extra U(1) charges collapse to familiar combinations and do not isolate the safe source. A universal binary sign also fails for three families because of a weak anomaly. The first surviving cyclic construction is a ℤ₉ lift whose observable gauge quotient is baryon triality.

claimDetails.heading: From continuous charges to triality
claimDetails.claim: A quotient here is like identifying clock readings that differ by a full turn: the larger bookkeeping group retains information needed for anomaly cancellation even when the low-energy observer sees only three classes.

claimDetails.heading: The current action and its limits
claimDetails.claim: The typed candidate action now separates BF memory, defect, reader, bosonic bulk, fermion capacity and response terms. A frozen point is healthy in all defined local bosonic sectors. Its classical stress tensor is also known term by term, with the pure BF term carrying no metric stress.

claimDetails.heading: The current action and its limits
claimDetails.claim: The remaining gaps are not a vague request for more elegance. They are a microscopic wall origin, a chiral fermion domain, a phase reference, an anomaly-free family operator, curved stress matching, an interacting spectrum and a device-specific signal.

claimDetails.heading: What the local result changes
claimDetails.claim: The H₂(ℝ) construction makes the Spin(2,3) middle rung concrete. It clarifies how response geometry, causal positivity and relational composition can meet.

claimDetails.heading: What it does not collapse
claimDetails.claim: J₃(𝕆), E₆, E₈, the Golay code, the Leech lattice, Conway symmetry and moonshine remain distinct structures with distinct jobs. The Leech pair-Gram construction reaches H₂(ℝ) and genus-two symplectic geometry, but needs an orientation twist and affine theta shift. No group-name chain substitutes for a carrier-preserving map.

claimDetails.heading: E₈ as a crystal rather than a slogan
claimDetails.claim: A crystal can be described by its rotations, translations, vibration modes and reciprocal lattice. None of those descriptions alone is the crystal, yet each reveals a real aspect. The charitable E₈ reading is similar: exceptional groups may organize compatible slices of one structure without every subgroup being a literal fundamental force.

claimDetails.heading: E₈ as a crystal rather than a slogan
claimDetails.claim: This avoids two opposite mistakes. One is to assume that embedding the Standard Model in a larger Lie group automatically derives chirality, generations and dynamics. The other is to dismiss exceptional structure because a particular Lie-algebra enlargement fails phenomenologically.

claimDetails.heading: Jordan freedom and the need for selectors
claimDetails.claim: Jordan algebras organize observables and positive state cones particularly well. Their strength is also their danger: many embeddings, real forms and idempotent choices are available. Without a selector, the theory can describe a landscape of possible measuring frames without choosing the one realized.

claimDetails.heading: Jordan freedom and the need for selectors
claimDetails.claim: Lie and Jordan methods are therefore not competing religions. Lie algebra controls infinitesimal symmetry; Jordan structure controls compatible observables and positivity. Both can be epistemically incomplete even if an underlying exceptional object is real.

claimDetails.heading: The corrected octonionic two-branch model
claimDetails.claim: The audited two-branch flow illustrates the discipline required. Its manuscript used the wrong invariant and phase symmetry, overcounted fixed points and treated instantaneous regions as persistent basins. After correction, the equations admit an exact two-mode squeezing Hamiltonian and completely positive loss model.

claimDetails.heading: The corrected octonionic two-branch model
claimDetails.claim: The resulting three bilinears form an SO(2,1) cone, while the four-real amplitude flow is conformally symplectic. Its Lie closure remains three-dimensional 𝔰𝔭(2,ℝ), not ten-dimensional 𝔰𝔭(4,ℝ). This is a useful open-system model and lower-rank control—not a derivation of fundamental Spin(2,3).

claimDetails.heading: Where the exceptional programme actually stands
claimDetails.claim: H₂(ℝ), J₃(𝕆), E₆, E₇, E₈, lattice constructions and moonshine occupy adjacent but non-identical levels. A legitimate continuation must specify a carrier map, preserve a stated invariant and end in an observable or a no-go test. Shared numbers and nested group names are clues for investigation, not evidence by themselves.

claimDetails.heading: How to challenge a claim
claimDetails.claim: Start with the claim's boundary sentence, then open its controlling source and executable verifier. Check whether the mathematical object is the same on both sides of every arrow: the same field space, symmetry action, domain and normalization. Many attractive false bridges change one of those silently.

claimDetails.heading: How to challenge a claim
claimDetails.claim: For a physical claim, also ask what prepared the state, what the measuring port couples to, which limits are taken and whether the quoted response belongs to the stated dynamics. The QWZ audit is the model example: the numerical quadrature was correct, but the stationary state of the written bath made the claimed response vanish.

claimDetails.heading: A compact vocabulary
claimDetails.claim: Carrier: the concrete space on which transformations act. Selector: a physical rule that chooses one option from a symmetric family. Domain: the boundary and regularity conditions that make an operator well defined. Residue: the strength with which a mode appears in a response. Anomaly: an obstruction that appears when a classical symmetry is required to survive quantization.

claimDetails.heading: A compact vocabulary
claimDetails.claim: These words name different jobs. A carrier does not select itself; a positive spectrum does not define a boundary domain; an index does not cancel an anomaly; and an experimental sensitivity does not predict a residue.

claimDetails.heading: Practical hope ends in work
claimDetails.claim: Hope becomes scientific when it says where to look and what useful work can return. A projector experiment may improve geometric control; a same-film response pipeline may improve force prediction; a null polarized-force search may tighten effective-field-theory bounds. The ordinary outcome must be worth having before any anomaly appears.

claimDetails.heading: Practical hope ends in work
claimDetails.claim: The same work may expose new physics only through a predeclared residual that survives calibration, nuisance models, reversals and competing mechanisms. Unexplained noise is not promoted by desire. The point is a two-outcome design: theoretical or engineering improvement under established physics, and a disciplined discovery route if the established account fails.

claimDetails.heading: Desired endpoints are aims
claimDetails.claim: The programme may desire a theory of joint realizability, a physical carrier dictionary, a derived selector, protected cross-response relations and a detector able to separate shared shape from shared mechanism. These aims orient work without becoming predictions.

claimDetails.heading: Desired endpoints are aims
claimDetails.claim: Desire does not make an endpoint true, while kenotic caution does not require pretending the programme has no direction. Each desired endpoint must be paired with a closure condition and a result that remains useful if the endpoint is not reached.

claimDetails.heading: Three roles are not three maxima
claimDetails.claim: Security, selfhood and kenosis become less paradoxical when they are typed as different mathematical roles: a viability boundary, an invariant carried through change and an outward flow. They are not three rival scalar objectives. The practical question is which trajectories preserve enough capacity and identity for something real to keep passing outward.

claimDetails.heading: Three roles are not three maxima
claimDetails.claim: This picture does not solve moral tragedy or derive an ethic from mathematics. It shows where a decision actually crosses a declared boundary, destroys an identity-bearing relation or spends future capacity. Values still choose among admissible paths; the feasible region does not choose its own objective.

claimDetails.heading: Mythic arcs are pictures
claimDetails.claim: Chaos becoming an inhabitable order, a traveller crossing a typed gate, a labyrinth retaining a thread, death opening into renewal and reconciliation without erasure can picture aspects of admission, transport, memory, closure and reopening. They are ways of seeing the human meaning of a pattern, not mechanisms in a physical model.

claimDetails.heading: Mythic arcs are pictures
claimDetails.claim: These pictures are a menu. Remove or substitute them and the scientific claim must remain unchanged. If a theorem or experiment depends on the mythic picture, the picture contains an unstated premise and has exceeded its authority.

claimDetails.heading: Theology under a declared assumption
claimDetails.claim: Assume explicitly that God exists; for the specific kenotic reading also assume that God is unsurpassable in knowledge, power and goodness, that creation is genuinely other and intelligible, and that divine power ordinarily serves rather than needlessly replaces creaturely causation. Under those assumptions, the admissibility story can picture creation as a hospitable lawful region in which distinct beings, causes, histories and records genuinely matter.

claimDetails.heading: Theology under a declared assumption
claimDetails.claim: An explicitly Christian continuation reads incarnation as entry into creaturely conditions, the cross as non-dominating power sharing their cost, and resurrection as restoration without erasure. This is positive theological analysis from declared premises, not an inference from Jordan/TKK mathematics, an anomaly or a gap in physics; no theological conclusion flows backward as evidence for a scientific claim.

claimDetails.heading: Theology under a declared assumption
claimDetails.claim: The pinned Claimipedia graph offers one bounded picture of presence without domination. Its principal kenosis node supports three undirected cycle classes and is an articulation, yet the authored arrows flow through it without directed return. Under the chapter's declared theological premises this may picture a load-bearing junction that does not force every relation to circulate around itself. The exact result remains graph topology: the node is present, not a puncture. The natural three-branch cover also has a filled triangular nerve and vanishing constant-coefficient H1, so matching scalar data glue uniquely. The smallest exact reopening template replaces that cover with three distinct pairwise overlaps and transition signs: product +1 permits a global nonzero marker, while product -1 returns it reversed. This is proposed new data, not an extraction; the current graph supplies neither the overlap loop nor its transitions, and no divine referent follows from either construction.

findings.title: The Jordan/TKK route reaches the Spin(2,3) hinge
findings.statement: For the declared four-real-dimensional carrier, Jordan translations, grading and a correctly typed continuous Furey channel rotation close the ten-dimensional real Lie algebra 𝔰𝔭(4,ℝ), hence Spin₀(2,3).
findings.boundary: This is a finite-dimensional model theorem, not evidence that nature selects the carrier or its interpretation.

findings.title: A concrete lower-rank Jordan entry point exists
findings.statement: The Gaussian residual selector is represented by the H₂(ℝ) logarithmic barrier and its Peirce–Schur recursion. Its conformal/TKK algebra supplies an explicit local rung into 𝔰𝔭(4,ℝ).
findings.boundary: H₂(ℝ) is not the exceptional Albert algebra; the later J₃(𝕆), E₆ and E₈ continuation remains a separate bridge.

findings.title: The odd-cycle intuition has a projective double-cover realization
findings.statement: The three-relation cycle supports an odd-loop obstruction, a connected six-cycle cover and a coherent central-sign lift. Nested six- and twelve-step transports make the twist and return data explicit.
findings.boundary: Central −I holonomy is not automatically chirality, a spacetime braid, a Pfaffian reversal or a generation count.

findings.title: The central sign is not the missing orientation datum
findings.statement: The canonical projective lift returns the carrier frame by −I while preserving determinant orientation. The direct identification of Wilson-loop sign with response-Pfaffian sheet therefore fails.
findings.boundary: A separate reflection, oriented area or other odd datum could still supply a typed orientation bridge.

findings.title: The Furey channel rotation participates in exact sp(4) closure
findings.statement: On the declared response carrier, the continuous Furey product rotation supplies the generator that enlarges the compact-turn/split-dilation subalgebra to 𝔰𝔭(4,ℝ).
findings.boundary: The response operator is an effective typed construction, not a microscopic Standard-Model Hamiltonian or a theorem about Furey's complete programme.

findings.title: One S₁ mediator cannot realize the desired pure Furey pulse
findings.statement: The common mediator producing the two crossed Standard-Model operators also produces a third Wilson edge. One copy is rank-obstructed; common-orientation positive copies do not remove it.
findings.boundary: A split-copy involution, source-incidence rule, boundary realization or physical reading of the closed triangle remains possible only with additional structure.

findings.title: Proton safety is a source-selection problem
findings.statement: The complete unified triplet contains the desired leptoquark arms together with four-quark and proton-decay channels. B−L and matter parity do not isolate the safe subset.
findings.boundary: This excludes the naive complete-multiplet reading, not every Pati–Salam, finite-geometry or multi-mediator completion.

findings.title: Pati–Salam finite geometry supplies a concrete source split
findings.statement: The retained Model C reconstruction separates leptoquark and diquark sources and reproduces opposite crossed coefficients; rank-one vacuum geometry protects selected mixing channels through the audited orders.
findings.boundary: Broken-phase counterterms, global anomalies and the third-edge burden remain open.

findings.title: The simplest continuous and binary protections fail
findings.statement: Family-universal anomaly-free U(1) charges reduce to familiar directions and cannot distinguish the safe mask. A universal internal Z₂ is weak-anomalous for an odd family count, while connected flavor removes the two-family sign exit.
findings.boundary: Larger cyclic, flavor-dependent, non-Abelian, inflow and finite-geometry mechanisms remain live.

findings.title: Baryon triality is the first surviving cyclic protection
findings.statement: The first family-universal cyclic witness appears at Z₉; quotienting its gauge cube leaves baryon triality. Three families cancel the audited low-energy residues.
findings.boundary: The full Pati–Salam bordism class, heavy-threshold descent and exact finite-spectral-triple normalizer remain open.

findings.title: The exceptional continuation remains a separate bridge
findings.statement: The local H₂(ℝ)/TKK result strengthens the route into Spin(2,3), but does not derive J₃(𝕆), E₆, E₈, Golay, Leech or Monster structure.
findings.boundary: Shared dimensions, labels and visual resemblance are not carrier maps; each continuation needs an explicit map, invariant and observable.

findings.title: Mathematical closure is not physical closure
findings.statement: The programme contains reproducible algebraic closure and microscopic candidates, but no selected action, vacuum, measure, recovered Standard-Model spectrum or target-blind prediction follows from closure alone.
findings.boundary: This is the principal firewall against presenting the programme as a completed theory of nature.

findings.title: Charge-three Higgsing has a precise topological limit
findings.statement: With the declared normalization, a compact charge-three Abelian Higgs sector reduces in the strict infrared to level-three BF theory. A gapped unit-charge reader may retain sector memory without becoming a topological degree of freedom.
findings.boundary: The charge-three phase does not create the required wall: its apparent vacua are gauge-equivalent. A separate defect origin and orientation history are required.

findings.title: A neutral kink supplies the minimal reader wall
findings.statement: Adding one neutral ℤ₂ order parameter produces an explicit kink and localizes one even, gapped, charge-one bosonic mode without mirror doubling.
findings.boundary: This is a minimal completion, not a derivation from the original action. Compact boundary conditions and the physical origin of the neutral field remain external.

findings.title: Healthy bosonic poles do not settle the chiral fold
findings.statement: A frozen tree-level benchmark has positive kinetic eigenvalues, nonnegative masses and positive residues for every defined bosonic sector.
findings.boundary: Reflection exchanges four-dimensional chirality. The undoubled chiral Standard Model has no declared same-representation partner, self-adjoint fold domain or boundary BRST cohomology.

findings.title: The selector is missing a physical phase reference
findings.statement: Endpoint-blind Standard-Model data cannot supply the exchange-odd portal needed to choose one non-fixed orientation. CP, CPT, ℤ₃, boundary normal, index and known flavour data do not canonically fix the remaining phase circle.
findings.boundary: A physical charge-minus-two complex reference and a local lock to the charged carrier would reopen the problem; merely renaming an existing phase does not.

findings.title: The canonical completion carries index three, but its minimal 6D parent is anomalous
findings.statement: The selected-projector completion canonically induces O(3) on ℂP¹, and the twisted Dirac operator has index three for every spectator Standard-Model representation.
findings.boundary: The simplest same-six-dimensional-chirality local parent has irreducible gravitational, gauge and global SU(2) anomalies. A vectorlike repair returns mirror zero modes.

findings.title: The traceless spectral threshold survives stress improvement
findings.statement: Within the displayed scalar improvement family, the traceless stress vertex and its pair-production threshold are independent of the curvature coupling xi.
findings.boundary: The full trace-mixed third response direction is not universal and can be tuned away. Curved microscopic matching and an operational port definition are still needed.

findings.title: A calibrated pole-and-band experiment can be specified
findings.statement: The A11 packet includes finite-volume, disorder, sector-confusion, calibration and statistical-power gates. Its synthetic fixture has an effective resolution floor near 0.630 MHz and resolves an injected 1 MHz shift.
findings.boundary: Sensitivity is not a predicted signal. The programme still lacks a microscopic sector shift, spectral residue and physical port operator.

findings.title: The softened QWZ curve is not the response of its stated Lindbladian
findings.statement: The published scalar-broadening quadrature and doubled cusp reproduce, but the stated unital L=σ_z dynamics generically drive each momentum sector to I/2. Exact stationary Kubo forcing therefore vanishes.
findings.boundary: The curve remains a phenomenological template. A non-unital bath, reservoir or finite-time preparation would define a different model and must be solved independently.

findings.title: The two-branch flow has an exact open-bosonic realization
findings.statement: After replacing the incorrect A-bar-B invariant by AB and common-phase symmetry by opposite-phase U(1), the two-branch flow closes on an SO(2,1) cone and is reproduced exactly by a two-mode squeezing Hamiltonian with completely positive loss.
findings.boundary: Its Lie closure is 𝔰𝔭(2,ℝ), not 𝔰𝔭(4,ℝ), and the octonionic bracket-to-bosonic-operator map remains assumed.

findings.title: Seven gates now have explicit stopping and reopening rules
findings.statement: A5 and A7 are internally exhausted; A2 and A9 are conditionally constructed; A4, A6 and A11 are externally open. No whole gate is globally failed.
findings.boundary: Physical admission remains false. Exhaustion means that recombining the same inputs is no longer frontier work, not that every possible completion is impossible.

findings.title: The local gravity route has one healthy critical torsion sector but no closed quantum parent
findings.statement: The reopened mass-gap and action programme isolates a healthy classical/EFT zero-minus torsion sector and a complete quadratic shell, while the local quantum flow leaves the critical surface through a Weyl-square term.
findings.boundary: Positive enlarged completions remain possible, but they import new functional, metric, vacuum or matching data and do not select the axial portal.

findings.title: Every finite connection-parent escape now ends at new model construction
findings.statement: Ordinary Lorentz super-Yang--Mills is kinetically indefinite; self-duality requires complex reality constraints; nonlinear Lorentz realization gives a massive rotation-vector triplet rather than the target pseudoscalar.
findings.boundary: This is operational exhaustion under current inputs, not a theorem against future models. Reopening requires a complete action, vacuum, constraint solution, positive spectrum and normalized fermion matching.

findings.title: The mixed admissibility interface is an A8 transfer lattice
findings.statement: For the declared 16-node, 27-relation quotient-scar graph, the constructive and guardrail incidence images intersect on the zero-sum integral lattice of a nine-node mixed core, hence A8 with determinant nine.
findings.boundary: The lattice is a corpus-derived transfer coordinate. It is not a physical A8 symmetry, octonion carrier, Leech lattice or exceptional-algebra identification; laboratory meaning requires an explicit cross-carrier map.

findings.title: The pinned Claimipedia operator layers contain sl2 plus sl3, not sp4
findings.statement: The full relationship-path algebra contributes sl2, the reciprocal programme core contributes exact A2/sl3, and the evidence and provenance layers contribute no further semisimple Lie factor.
findings.boundary: This is an exhaustive result for the fixed captured schema, not a physical symmetry claim. Reopening requires a new evidence-bound cross-operator on one shared carrier satisfying the C2 Cartan, Serre and nondegenerate symplectic-form tests.

frontiers.title: Derive the defect rather than insert it
frontiers.question: What microscopic action creates the neutral wall, its orientation and a globally compatible compact domain?

frontiers.stop: Do not keep manipulating gauge-equivalent charge-three phases as though they were disconnected vacua.

frontiers.stop: A positive bosonic benchmark does not establish unitarity of the chiral theory.

frontiers.title: Supply a physical phase reference
frontiers.question: What measured or history-bearing charge-minus-two datum chooses the sterile phase axis and locks it locally to the charged carrier?
frontiers.advance: A gauge-complete local operator selects the whole orientation without target-dependent convention.
frontiers.stop: Searches among already-audited symmetric data are exhausted.

frontiers.title: Make index three anomaly-free and mirror-free
frontiers.question: Can a local or spectral real structure retain three complete chiral families while cancelling the full higher-dimensional anomaly polynomial?
frontiers.advance: The construction supplies sterile pairing, cancels local and global anomalies and has no independent mirror kernel.
frontiers.stop: The integer three and O(3) bundle are not by themselves a physical family derivation.

frontiers.title: Match the stress operator in curved microscopic theory
frontiers.question: Which renormalization condition fixes improvement, contact terms, displacement operators and the common physical probe?
frontiers.advance: One completed action predicts the renormalized stress vertex and port map at a stated scale.
frontiers.stop: The full third matrix direction must remain secondary while its improvement dependence is unfixed.

frontiers.title: Predict a causal interacting spectrum
frontiers.question: What microscopic Hamiltonian predicts the sector-dependent pole, residue, linewidth and band support?
frontiers.advance: A causal positive spectral density survives disorder, calibration and held-out sector labels with the port fixed in advance.
frontiers.stop: A static covariance, scalar linewidth or phenomenological curve is not an interacting response derivation.

frontiers.title: Turn sensitivity into a physical test
frontiers.question: What device model predicts an absolute signal before data are unblinded, and can a protected ℤ₃ sector actually be prepared?
frontiers.advance: A powered experiment tests a preregistered effect size with independently verified sector algebra and scaling.
frontiers.stop: Three settings of a continuous U(1) control are not protected ℤ₃ sectors.

frontiers.title: Derive the missing anisotropies
frontiers.question: Can an action generate the addressed controls that enlarge the natural 𝔰𝔭(2,ℝ) response symmetry to all ten generators of 𝔰𝔭(4,ℝ)?
frontiers.advance: Orientation and anisotropy arise dynamically and ten-generator closure survives loss, disorder and refinement.
frontiers.stop: A four-real carrier or conformally symplectic flow alone is not full Spin(2,3).

frontiers.title: Construct the protected torsion parent
frontiers.question: Which complete microscopic theory contains a nondegenerate vacuum, a positive independent zero-minus connection pole and a protected normalized axial-current coupling?
frontiers.advance: One action passes the reality, constraint, spectrum, radiative-protection and threshold-matching gates without importing the answer as a free coefficient.
frontiers.stop: Another symmetry label, projector or quadratic parameter scan cannot replace the missing model.

frontiers.title: Realize one mixed-interface return on a calibrated carrier
frontiers.question: Can one platform co-realize the wall-response return or supply the missing orientation datum in the selection-memory-holonomy return?
frontiers.advance: A preregistered detector records the predicted invariant, nuisance model and return law on held-out data without refitting the bridge coefficient.
frontiers.stop: The abstract A8 transfer lattice is not a laboratory conservation law or physical symmetry without an explicit carrier map.
